alarm.name: HealthcareApi-Http5xx
alarm.stateReason: 5xx responses exceeded the threshold for five minutes

observations.summary: DatabaseConnections remained at the configured maximum.
Requests failed while waiting for a connection from the application pool.
Request concurrency exceeded the configured application pool capacity while database CPU and storage remained healthy.
DatabaseConnections reached the ceiling together with the concurrency rise and stayed flat there, rather than climbing monotonically while request volume held steady.
Checked-out connections returned to the pool after each request completed, and no session-not-returned warning appears in the window.
No deployment precedes the onset, and the running task definition revision enables none of the injectable fault flags.
